Name: Another Smaller Farmhouse Map
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Another smaller Farmhouse map, this time tweaked for compatibility with the Attic mod and NPCs that have heart events in the kitchen
Description:
_Description_

*   Another smaller Farmhouse map for that cozy feel, this time tweaked for compatibility with the Attic mod and NPCs that have heart events in the kitchen
_Compatibility_

*   Not mobile compatible

*   Compatible with mods that change the cellar

*   Only makes the fully upgraded farmhouse smaller, so will not conflict with mods editing earlier stages of the farmhouse

*   Works with [Bathroom replaces spouseroom](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12150), though you should uncheck "bachelor mode" when you fully upgrade your farmhouse if you're still unmarried. You can then use [SpouseRoom Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12187)﻿﻿ to set up your spouse's room somewhere else in the farmhouse if you want. If you want a bathroom "just for looks" use the furniture version included in my [big furniture pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240) or [adorable cottage bathroom furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10982).﻿﻿

*   If you plan on marrying Olivia from SVE use the "open bedroom" renovation at Robin's so the kitchen is open plan

*   Compatible with the [Attic for Farmhouse](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10203)﻿, but you need to add this mod to that mod's false dependencies by pasting this script into the manifest.json
``___Other mods I've made that work well with this one_

*   [Customisable Empty Spouse Rooms with NPC furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11641)

*   [Beam recolor mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597)

*   [Crib flooring fix](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12602)﻿
